about.title: About Ben's
about.paragraph1: Ben's Resto Café is a family business. The owner is in the dining room every day. The kitchen serves Tunisian and Italian food: couscous, salads, pizzas, calzones, pasta, meat and seafood dishes. On arrival, tea, harissa and tuna are offered as a complimentary starter.
about.paragraph2: The terrace is large, tables are well spaced. The neighbourhood cats are regulars here too.
about.paragraph3: The restaurant opens at 7:00 am. Mornings are for coffee and breakfast. The kitchen then runs through to the evening, seven days a week.

matchs.title: Match nights at Ben's
matchs.paragraph: Inside, a large screen shows the matches. Regulars settle in for the evening, a plate or a coffee on the table.
